items.text: Budget forecast summary for Q3: the finance team used the automated forecasting tool to model three scenarios and shared the results in the Monday pack. The baseline assumes flat contractor costs through September. The optimistic case adds two new client accounts but keeps headcount unchanged. The pessimistic case models a 12% drop in renewals and a freeze on discretionary spend. Department heads should review the scenario that best matches their pipeline before the 20 June planning meeting. Any corrections to the assumptions go to Priya Anand in FP&A.

items.text: Grant application guidance page: the Brightpath Foundation expects a two-page narrative, a project timeline and a budget table submitted through its online form. Last cycle the automated review tool returned most applicants within five working days, so the team plans to file by 30 September to leave room for corrections. The narrative should explain how the literacy programme will reach at least 150 pupils in the first year. Supporting letters from partner schools are optional but recommended. Questions about eligibility go to the programme office, and a FAQ section covers the matching-funds rule in detail.
